Sandbox_LSC_ModEnabled_tooltip: Enables or disables the mod. When disabled all thresholds will be ignored and object properties will be reset to defaults if attacked.
Sandbox_LSC_DebugEnabled_tooltip: Enables or disables debug prints in the console.
Sandbox_LSC_ThresholdPerLevel_tooltip: How much should be added to the zombie threshold per level of an object.
